source: Branded products sold in Malta and the EU, read from each product's own nutrition-label photo (Open Food Facts images) or the brand's page. Oath food sprint, 29 Oct 2026: every value checked against the source named on it (see food-sprint/changelog.csv).

items.name: Twistees Cheesy
items.notes: Per 100 g as printed on the pack (1842 kJ); read on 2026-10-29 from the nutrition-label photo on Open Food Facts (https://images.openfoodfacts.org/images/products/535/012/299/9900/3.jpg, photo uploaded 2021-11-16), and the per-pack column (221 kcal / 921 kJ per 50 g pack) agrees. The manufacturer's site publishes no nutrition values. Fibre is not declared. rice, rapeseed oil, cheese powder (milk) 6.73%, yeast extract, whey powder (milk), paprika, salt (OFF transcription). The OFF entry for the 150 g sharing bag (5350122000002, no label photo) lists different values (2039 kJ, fat 26.8 g, carbs 55 g), so the recipe may have changed since this 2021 photo. Labels change: check the current pack.

items.name: Twistees Sour Cream & Onion
items.notes: Per 100 g as printed on the pack (1938 kJ); read on 2026-10-29 from the nutrition-label photo on Open Food Facts (https://images.openfoodfacts.org/images/products/535/012/200/0637/nutrition_en.5.full.jpg, photo uploaded 2025-05-30), and the per-pack column (232 kcal / 969 kJ per 50 g pack, 116 kcal per 25 g serving) agrees. The manufacturer's site publishes no nutrition values. Fibre is not declared. bilingual English/Maltese label (Fatti Nutrizzjonali); made on a line handling peanuts. Labels change: check the current pack.

items.name: Twistees Smoky BBQ
items.notes: Per 100 g as printed on the pack (2000 kJ); read on 2026-10-29 from the nutrition-label photo on Open Food Facts (https://images.openfoodfacts.org/images/products/535/012/299/9962/2.jpg, photo uploaded 2021-07-30), and the per-pack column (239 kcal / 1000 kJ per 50 g pack, 119.5 kcal per 25 g serving) agrees. The manufacturer's site publishes no nutrition values. Fibre is not declared. rice 58.7%, rapeseed oil, whey powder (milk), barbeque flavour 11.8% (milk), salt (OFF transcription). Labels change: check the current pack.

items.name: McCain Potato Hash Browns, oven baked
items.notes: Per 100 g oven baked, from the 'Per 100g Oven Baked' column of the UK 625 g pack label (851 kJ). The same label gives 164 kcal per 100 g frozen (the existing record brand:mccain:potato-hash-browns, which matches it exactly) and 186 kcal per 100 g air fried. Sugars are left unknown: the photo reads 0.5 g but the McCain UK page publishes '<0.5g', as noted on the frozen record. Log this record with the cooked weight; log the as-sold record with the frozen weight.

items.name: Mini Babybel Original
items.notes: Per 100 g from the German-language EU pack label (1225 kJ / 295 kcal; 59 kcal per 20 g cheese). Carbohydrate and sugars are declared as '<0.01 g' and stored as 0, the trace convention used for CoFID 'Tr'. An older UK label photo (2018) on the same OFF database showed 308 kcal, fat 24 g, protein 23 g, so the recipe or rounding changed; this is the newer label.

items.name: Oatly Oat Drink Barista Edition
items.notes: Per 100 ml from the EU (DE/NL/FR/PL) 1 L carton label (257 kJ / 61 kcal); the label also declares iodine 22.5 µg, which has no column here. Sugars 3.4 g as declared on the label. No density is declared, so ml-to-gram conversion is not set.

items.name: Optimum Nutrition Gold Standard 100% Whey, Double Rich Chocolate (powder)
items.notes: Per 100 g powder from the multilingual EU bag label (1565 kJ / 374 kcal; per 31 g serving 116 kcal, 24 g protein; about 15 servings per 465 g bag). Powder only: log milk or water separately. Whey isolate is the first ingredient on this product, so it is a whey blend rather than a pure concentrate or isolate.

items.name: Ponti Glassa (balsamic glaze) with Aceto Balsamico di Modena IGP
items.notes: Per 100 g from the Italian bottle label (819 kJ / 195 kcal). Ingredients: cooked grape must, Aceto Balsamico di Modena IGP 38%, modified maize starch, xanthan gum, caramel E150d; contains sulphites. Energy above 4/4/9 factors is the acetic acid (3 kcal/g). Per 100 g, not per 100 ml: a glaze is denser than water.

items.name: Brave Roasted Chickpeas, Sweet Chilli
items.notes: Per 100 g from the UK/EU multilingual pack label (1607 kJ / 384 kcal; 134 kcal per 35 g serving, about 3.3 servings per pack). OFF lists 1492 kJ, which does not match the printed label; the label is used. Sweet chilli seasoning; plain or other flavours differ slightly.

items.name: Saitaku Udon Noodles, dry
items.notes: Per 100 g dry noodles from the multilingual EU label (1492 kJ / 356 kcal); fibre not declared. Weigh dry. Pre-cooked vacuum-packed udon has far more water and needs its own label.

items.name: Brincsons Galletti, original Maltese crackers
items.notes: Per 100 g from the Maltese pack label (1668 kJ / 394 kcal). Front of pack: 'Galletti - Original Maltese Crackers', Brincsons Quality, 'No added flavourings & preservatives'. Ingredients (OFF transcription): wheat flour, palm fat, wheat semolina, wheat gluten, yeast, sunflower oil, salt, wheat malt flour, milk protein, dried egg white, egg yolk powder, raising agents. Pack weight not visible on the photos.

items.name: Appetitoso pea pastizzi, frozen
items.notes: Per 100 g as sold from the pack label (1372 kJ / 329 kcal) of Dolceria Appetitoso, Għargħur, Malta: tray label 'PASTIZZI PIZELLI, QTY 15, appx 999g', 'store in freezer'. The label does not say whether the values are for the frozen or the baked pastizz; they are stored as sold (frozen). The portion is the pack weight divided by 15.

items.name: Camel Brand Bigilla Pikkanti (spicy broad bean dip)
items.notes: Per typical 100 g from the tub label (516.81 kJ / 124.62 kcal); fibre is not declared. Front of pack (2025 photo): Camel Brand, Qormi, Malta, 200 g; ingredients tic beans (ful), non-hydrogenated sunflower oil, garlic, pepper, parsley, salt. The 2023 label photo reads 'approx 250g', so the tub size has changed.

items.name: Camel Brand Ħelwa tat-Tork (Maltese halva)
items.notes: Per typical 100 g from the tub label (2087 kJ / 497 kcal); Camel Brand, Qormi, Malta, 'approx 250g, origin Malta'. Fibre is printed as 0 g and magnesium as 11.5 mg, both low for a sesame-based sweet, but they are kept as printed. Saturated + mono + poly (23.6 g) is below total fat (31.8 g) as printed.

items.name: Caffe Cordina The Maltese Figolla
items.notes: Per 100 g from the box label (1812 kJ / 433 kcal). Front: 'The Maltese Figolla - a hand-made sweet pastry with pure natural almond filling, covered with fondant', Caffe Cordina. Weight per figolla not visible on the photos; label photo from 2019.

items.name: Da Vinci traditional ricotta pastizzi, frozen
items.notes: Per 100 g from the tray label (920 kJ / 220 kcal) of Artisan Foods Company Ltd (Da Vinci Pasticceria), Naxxar, Malta: 'Traditional Pastizzi Ricotta x 9, approx 500g', stored frozen at -18 C and baked from defrosted at 220 C for 15 minutes, so the values are for the unbaked frozen pastizz. Ricotta 19%; fibre not declared. Portion = pack weight / 9. Much lower in fat than the Appetitoso pea pastizzi label (20.8 g).

items.name: Caffe Cordina Krustini (Maltese almond biscuits)
items.notes: Per 100 g from the box label (1893 kJ / 452 kcal); OFF transcribes carbohydrate as 61.03 g but the label prints 61.3 g. Label photo from 2018, so check the current box.

items.name: Myprotein Impact Whey Isolate, unflavoured (powder)
items.notes: Per 100 g powder from the multilingual 2.5 kg bag label (1537 kJ / 362 kcal; per 30 g serving 109 kcal, 26 g protein; 83 servings). Ingredients: whey protein isolate (milk) 100% (contains emulsifiers soya and sunflower lecithin). Fibre not declared. Powder only: log milk or water separately.

items.name: SiS GO Electrolyte, orange (powder)
items.notes: Per 100 g powder from the tub label (1553 kJ / 365 kcal; per 40 g serving 146 kcal, 36 g carbohydrate, sodium 237 mg). Label also gives sodium 593 mg/100 g (salt 1.48 g is that sodium x 2.5). A carbohydrate-electrolyte drink, not a zero-sugar electrolyte tablet. Powder grams only: water is logged separately. Orange flavour (front of tub); label version SIS 702388 V3 03/23.

items.name: Maypole Maltese White Large Sliced (Maltese bread)
items.notes: Per 100 g from the bakery label (998 kJ / 239 kcal) of Maypole Ltd, Qormi, Malta: 'Maltese White Large Sliced', 415 g, ingredients wheat flour, water, salt, yeast only. A labelled Maltese loaf, unlike hobz-tal-malti-as-sold, which is an estimate copied from US French/Vienna bread (272 kcal, fat 2.4 g, protein 10.8 g). Weigh slices; slice weight is not printed.

items.name: David's Bakery White Sliced Bread (Gozo)
items.notes: Per 100 g from the bag label (1170 kJ / 275 kcal) of David's Bakery, Kerċem, Gozo; 500 g. A sandwich-style loaf (with sugar, emulsifiers, vegetable oil), not the crusty ħobż tal-Malti. Label photo from 2019.

items.name: EMY Original Green Peas (crunchy pea snack)
items.notes: Per 100 g from the bag label (1536 kJ / 367 kcal) of EMY Enterprises Ltd, Malta; 220 g bag. Label photo from 2019.

items.name: EMY Chilli Broad Beans (fried broad bean snack)
items.notes: Per 100 g from the bag label (1686 kJ / 403 kcal) of EMY ("Taste the Quality"), Malta. Pack weight not visible on the photos.

items.name: Maltese nougat bar with pistachio (qubbajt)
items.notes: Per 100 g from the wrapper label (1684 kJ / 399 kcal) of a Maltese white nougat bar with pistachio pieces sold under a 'MALTA' Maltese-cross wrapper (Maltese GS1 prefix 535). The manufacturer's name is not visible on the photos. Soft white nougat; almond qubbajt from festa stalls differs.

items.name: Monin Toasted Hazelnut syrup (Noisette Grillée)
items.notes: Per 100 ml from the French 33 cl bottle label (1318 kJ / 315 kcal). Ingredients: sugar, water, flavouring, concentrated lemon juice, caramel colour, potassium sorbate; contains hazelnut extract. Label photo from 2018. Log by ml (one bar pump is about 10 ml, not printed on this label); no density is declared, so ml-to-gram conversion is not set.

items.name: Golden Harvest French Sliced Wholemeal loaf
items.notes: Per 100 g from the bakery label of Golden Harvest (Malta, since 1946): 1036 kJ / 245.1 kcal; also mono-unsaturates 0.4 g, poly-unsaturates 1.3 g, polyols 0.0 g, starch 43.0 g. Slice weight 33 g worked out from the label per-slice column (81.7 kcal per slice / 245.1 kcal per 100 g); the front panel shows 82 kcal per slice. The slice header on the photo is partly hidden by glare.

items.name: Golden Harvest Vivos Wholemeal loaf
items.notes: Per 100 g from the Golden Harvest Vivos label: 1107.8 kJ / 262.4 kcal; starch 48.0 g, polyols 0.0 g; salt 0.012 g (front panel per slice: 88 kcal, fat 0.5 g, sugar 0.2 g, fibre 2.1 g). Slice 33 g as printed (P/slice 33g). Label photo is from 2018; the current pack may differ, so re-check against a current pack.

items.name: Golden Harvest Pita White Small (6 pack)
items.notes: Per 100 g from the label ("Nutritional Declaration for 100g"): 1271.4 kJ / 299.8 kcal. Ingredients: wheat flour, water, yeast, sugar, preservatives (E282, E200), salt, sunflower oil. The photo does not show the pack or pita weight, so no portion is given.

items.name: Savina Gozitan peppered sheep's cheeselets
items.notes: Per 100 g from the label (1470 kJ / 353 kcal). Front: 'Crafted Gozitan Cheeselets, 2 peppered sheep's cheeselets'; ingredients (Italian panel): pasteurised sheep's milk, wine vinegar, sea salt, ground black pepper 1.6%, rennet; Maltese health mark MT DP 003 KE. Pack weight 83 g from OFF; 1 cheeselet = 83 g / 2 (average piece, derived).

items.name: Safari Orange Juice 100%
items.notes: Per 100 ml from the carton label (197.0 kJ / 47.0 kcal; vitamin C 52 mg = 65.5% NRV). "This pack contains 5 servings of 200 mL"; front: Safari Orange Juice 100%, 1 L. Barcode prefix 5352206 is Maltese (same company prefix as Coolee). Label photo is from 2021; the current pack may differ, so re-check against a current pack.

items.name: Safari Peach Juice Drink (30% fruit)
items.notes: Per 100 ml from the label (208 kJ / 49 kcal). Ingredients: water, peach purée (30%) from purée concentrate, sugar, citric acid, ascorbic acid, flavouring. Not 100% juice. Label photo is from 2017; the current pack may differ, so re-check against a current pack.

items.name: Lamb Brand Original Breadcrumbs
items.notes: Per 100 g from the label (1563 kJ / 369 kcal). Front: 'Original Breadcrumbs, plain crushed toasted bread sticks', Lamb Brand, 1 kg. Ingredients: wheat flour '0', water, salt, beer yeast. Label photo is from 2021; the current pack may differ, so re-check against a current pack.

items.name: KusKus Mushroom & Parsley Couscous (prepared)
items.notes: Per 100 g AS CONSUMED (made with boiling water), as the label states ('Typical value per 100g as consumed': 590 kJ / 141 kcal); not the dry mix. Front: KusKus 'Festa of Flavours' Mushroom & Parsley Couscous, Lamb Brand, 2+1 sachets x 100 g, 'just add boiling water'.

items.name: Sunshine Snacks Crix Peanut
items.notes: Per 100 g from the label (2091 kJ / 500 kcal). Sunshine Snacks is a Consolidated Biscuit Co. (Malta) snack brand (Maltese GS1 prefix 5351904). Pack size not shown on the photo.

items.name: Sunshine Snacks Crix Cheese
items.notes: Per 100 g from the label (2160 kJ / 517 kcal). The OFF nutrition table says 571 kcal, which does not match the label photo; the label is used. Label photo is from 2021; the current pack may differ, so re-check against a current pack.

items.name: Sunshine Snacks Krips Potato Fries
items.notes: Per 100 g from the label (2009 kJ / 479 kcal; per 30 g 603 kJ / 144 kcal). Salt 4.5 g per 100 g as printed. Label photo is from 2020; the current pack may differ, so re-check against a current pack.

items.name: Sunshine Snacks Microwave Popcorn, Salted (unpopped)
items.notes: Per 100 g of the product as sold (kernels with fat and salt, before popping), from the label (1788 kJ / 428 kcal). Made in France for Consolidated Biscuit Co. Ltd., Mriehel, Birkirkara, Malta. Label photo is from 2020; the current pack may differ, so re-check against a current pack.

items.name: Sunshine Snacks Popcorn, White Cheddar Cheese flavour
items.notes: Per 100 g from the label (2374 kJ / 570 kcal), ready-to-eat popped snack. OFF lists a 55 g bag; the bag size is not on the photo.

items.name: Twistees Reduced Fat & Salt, 50 g
items.notes: Per 100 g from the label (1785 kJ / 425 kcal; per pack 213 kcal, per 25 g serving 106.5 kcal). Pack weight 50 g worked out from the per-pack column (213 / 425 x 100 = 50 g) and matching the 2 x 25 g servings. Fibre not declared. Label photo is from 2021; the current pack may differ, so re-check against a current pack.

items.name: Waistnot Beef Biryani ready meal, 300 g
items.notes: Per 100 g from the label (697 kJ / 166 kcal); serving size 300 g = 499 kcal as printed. Waistnot meals are made in Malta (another Waistnot label on OFF, 5350295553978, names The Food Factory, Zejtun, Malta, and says to heat from frozen); the biryani photo itself does not show the storage line.

items.name: Vera Caponata
items.notes: Per 100 g from the jar label (566 kJ / 136 kcal). Vera is a Vernons (Malta) brand (Maltese GS1 prefix 5352002; the Vera tomato paste label gives the Vernons Malta address). OFF lists a 190 g jar; the size is not on this photo.

items.name: Blue Angel Tuna Chunks in Sunflower Oil, drained
items.notes: Per 100 g drained, from the label ("Amount per 100g (drained)": 170 kcal / 710 kJ). Ingredients: tuna (Katsuwonus pelamis) 67.0%, sunflower oil, water, salt; net weight 170 g, net drained weight 120 g. Maltese GS1 prefix 5350279. Label photo is from 2018; the current pack may differ, so re-check against a current pack.

items.name: X-Tra Skipjack Tuna Chunks in Sunflower Oil, drained
items.notes: Per 100 g drained product, from two label photos (2021 and 2023) that agree: 751 kJ / 180 kcal; carbohydrate printed as <0.1 g (recorded as 0). Ingredients: skipjack tuna (fish), sunflower oil, water, salt. Maltese GS1 prefix 5351905. Can size not shown on the nutrition photos (OFF lists 160 g).

items.name: Aster Mackerel in Tomato Sauce, 155 g
items.notes: Per 100 g from the label (765 kJ / 183 kcal), whole can contents (mackerel 58.1%, tomato sauce 41.9%). Net weight 155 g, drained weight 90 g. Packed in China for AMSM Ltd, Marsa, Malta.

items.name: Olly's Beef Burger
items.notes: Per 100 g product, from the label (1059 kJ / 255 kcal); carbohydrate and sugars printed as <0.1 g (recorded as 0). Maltese GS1 prefix 5350507. Burger and pack weight not shown on the photo.

items.name: 7UP (Malta bottling), 500 ml
items.notes: Per 100 ml from the bottle label (29 kcal / 121 kJ; per 500 ml 145 kcal). Salt printed as 36 mg per 100 ml (0.036 g). The barcode carries the Maltese GS1 company prefix 5352201, the same as Kinnie and as the Pepsi bottle whose label states it is bottled by Simonds Farsons Cisk plc, Mriehel, Malta (OFF 5352201084118, photo 2). The UK 7UP records in this database are a different (UK) recipe. Label photo is from 2021; the current pack may differ, so re-check against a current pack.

items.name: Britvic Indian Tonic Water (Malta bottling)
items.notes: Per 100 ml from the label (26 kcal / 111 kJ). The barcode carries the Maltese GS1 company prefix 5352201, the same as Kinnie and as the Pepsi bottle whose label states it is bottled by Simonds Farsons Cisk plc, Mriehel, Malta (OFF 5352201084118, photo 2). Bottle size not on the photo. Label photo is from 2019; the current pack may differ, so re-check against a current pack.

items.name: Golden Harvest Wholemeal Family Loaf
items.notes: Per 100 g from the label (1034.3 kJ / 244.8 kcal; starch 42 g, polyols 0 g); slice 26 g as printed (P/slice 26g, 81.59 kcal). Golden Harvest (Malta, "since 1946"; Maltese GS1 prefix 5351908).

items.name: Golden Harvest GI Loaf Multiseed
items.notes: Per 100 g from the label (1157 kJ / 275.2 kcal; starch 35.3 g, polyols 0.0 g); slice 33 g as printed (91.7 kcal per slice). Golden Harvest (Malta, "since 1946"; Maltese GS1 prefix 5351908).

items.name: Golden Harvest Jumbo White sliced loaf
items.notes: Per 100 g from the label (1083.5 kJ / 255.8 kcal; starch 48.9 g, polyols 0.0 g); slice 32 g as printed (81.9 kcal per slice). Golden Harvest (Malta, "since 1946"; Maltese GS1 prefix 5351908). Label photo is from 2018; the current pack may differ, so re-check against a current pack.

items.name: Jesper's White Loaf
items.notes: Per 100 g from the label (920 kJ / 220 kcal; sodium 410 mg, salt 1.0 g as printed); slice 33 g as printed (73 kcal per slice). Jesper's is the Danish Bakery Limited brand, B22 Industrial Estate, Bulebel ZTN 3000, Malta (address printed on the Jesper's labels).

items.name: Jesper's Multigrains Loaf, 600 g
items.notes: Per 100 g from the label (1070 kJ / 254 kcal); net weight 600 g. Jesper's is the Danish Bakery Limited brand, B22 Industrial Estate, Bulebel ZTN 3000, Malta (address printed on the Jesper's labels).

items.name: Jesper's Multiseed Loaf, 600 g
items.notes: Per 100 g from the label (1081 kJ / 257 kcal); net weight 600 g. Jesper's is the Danish Bakery Limited brand, B22 Industrial Estate, Bulebel ZTN 3000, Malta (address printed on the Jesper's labels).

items.name: David's Bakery Spelt & Honey sliced bread (Gozo)
items.notes: Per 100 g from the label (1100 kJ / 260 kcal). Front: David's Bakery Gozo, 'Spelt & Honey sliced bread, 100% spelt cereal flour product'. Label photo is from 2021; the current pack may differ, so re-check against a current pack.

items.name: Golden Harvest Gluten Free Krekketti with garlic, 100 g
items.notes: Per 100 g from the label (1642.7 kJ / 390.6 kcal). Front: 'Gluten Free Krekketti savoury crackers, with garlic', 100 g. Gluten-free status is the maker's front-of-pack claim and is not added to any field here. Golden Harvest (Malta, "since 1946"; Maltese GS1 prefix 5351908). Label photo is from 2021; the current pack may differ, so re-check against a current pack.

items.name: Tal-Furnar Galletti, traditional Maltese water crackers
items.notes: Per 100 g from the label (1743 kJ / 411 kcal). Front: Tal-Furnar 'Galletti, traditional Maltese water crackers', value pack (pack weight not on the photos). Tal-Furnar is a Consolidated Biscuit / Alf. Mizzi brand (Maltese GS1 prefix 5351904). Label photo is from 2019; the current pack may differ, so re-check against a current pack.

items.name: Tal-Furnar Galletti with sea salt and cracked pepper
items.notes: Per 100 g from the label (1680 kJ / 396 kcal; the table also has a per-150 g column). Front: 'Galletti with sea salt and cracked pepper', value pack. The OFF nutrition table for this barcode (264 kcal, protein 1.07 g) does not match the photo; the photo is used. Tal-Furnar is a Consolidated Biscuit / Alf. Mizzi brand (Maltese GS1 prefix 5351904).

items.name: Tal-Furnar Galletti with ġbejniet tal-bżar flavour
items.notes: Per 100 g from the label (1767 kJ / 419 kcal). Ingredients include goat's cheese (5.1%) and 1.7% cracked pepper. Tal-Furnar is a Consolidated Biscuit / Alf. Mizzi brand (Maltese GS1 prefix 5351904).

items.name: Devon Traditional Galletti, Maltese water crackers, 350 g
items.notes: Per 100 g from the label (1746 kJ / 412 kcal; photo 2021). Front (2024): Devon Traditional Galletti, Maltese water crackers, extra value pack; OFF names it 350 g. Devon shares the Maltese GS1 prefix 5351904 with Tal-Furnar and Sunshine Snacks. Label photo is from 2021; the current pack may differ, so re-check against a current pack.

items.name: Tal-Furnar Ottijiet bil-Ġunġlien, traditional sesame seed biscuits, 250 g
items.notes: Per 100 g from the label (1873 kJ / 446 kcal); net weight 250 g. Front: Tal-Furnar 'Ottijiet bil-Ġunġlien, traditional sesame seed biscuits'; produced in Cyprus for Alf. Mizzi & Sons (Marketing) Ltd, Marsa, Malta. Maltese name as printed on the pack.

items.name: Tal-Lajku Qassatelli (Gozo), about 400 g
items.notes: Per 100 g from the printed label (1519.4 kJ / 359.7 kcal; fibre not declared). Produced by Tal-Lajku Dolceria, Xagħra, Gozo; 'Traditional Maltese'; weight approx. 400 g. Ingredients include peanuts and almond essence.

items.name: S.P.A.L. Traditional Maltese Nougat (torrone), 150 g
items.notes: Per 100 g from the label (1918 kJ / 454 kcal; the table also gives the whole 150 g bar). Front: 'Traditional Maltese Nougat, Torrone', made by S.P.A.L., St Venera, Malta, net weight 150 g. Alias 'qubbajt' from Visit Malta ('qubbajt (nougat)', https://www.visitmalta.com/en/a-taste-of-malta/). Label photo is from 2019; the current pack may differ, so re-check against a current pack.

items.name: Caffe Cordina Nougat Delights
items.notes: Per 100 g from the box label (2143 kJ / 512 kcal). Front: Caffe Cordina (since 1837) 'Maltese speciality: Nougat Delights, bite-sized treats of traditional nougat in chocolate, orange, lemon and vanilla'. Box weight not on the photos.

items.name: Philip Confectionery Maltese Traditional Biscuits
items.notes: Per 100 g from the label (1639 kJ / 391 kcal). Front: Philip Confectionery, Vincenzo Bugeja Street, St Venera, 'Maltese Traditional Biscuits' (pink-iced biscuits in the photo). Pack weight not shown. Label photo is from 2019; the current pack may differ, so re-check against a current pack.

items.name: Unique Kunserva (tomato paste from Maltese tomatoes), 260 g

items.name: Britvic Ginger Ale (Malta bottling)

items.name: Coca-Cola (Malta bottling)

items.name: Schweppes Ginger Ale (Malta bottling)
items.notes: Per 100 ml from the label (87 kJ / 20 kcal); fat, saturates and protein 'negligible amount', recorded as 0. Glass bottle (size not on the photo). Malta bottling: Maltese GS1 prefix 5352205 (the prefix of the Malta-bottled Coca-Cola system products on OFF).

items.name: Schweppes Indian Tonic Water (Malta bottling)
items.notes: Per 100 ml from the label (89 kJ / 21 kcal); fat, saturates and protein 'negligible amount', recorded as 0. Glass bottle (size not on the photo). Malta bottling: Maltese GS1 prefix 5352205 (the prefix of the Malta-bottled Coca-Cola system products on OFF).

items.name: FAGE Total 2% strained Greek yogurt, 950 g
items.notes: Per 100 g from the tub label (293 kJ / 70 kcal; calcium 121 mg = 15% NRV); fibre not declared. Front: FAGE Total 2% fat. items.name: Delta genuine Greek yogurt 0% fat, coffee, 170 g

Label photo is from 2021; the current pack may differ, so re-check against a current pack.
